evals.prompt: I added a new skill to my central skills repo. Sync everything for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
evals.expected_output: Runs the one repository sync command and reports that a new conversation is needed, not a Conductor restart.

evals.prompt: I deleted two skills from /Users/marclamy/Documents/Code/skills. Rebuild my installed skills so those deleted ones are gone everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Runs the clean rebuild command, allowing repository deletions to remove globally installed personal skills.

evals.prompt: Refresh all my agent skills. Do I need to restart Conductor afterwards?
evals.expected_output: Runs the sync command and explains that a fresh conversation is sufficient; Conductor does not need to restart.

evals.prompt: Install cool-skill from https://skills.sh/example/tools/cool-skill and sync it everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Adds 'cool-skill | https://skills.sh/example/tools/cool-skill' to skill-inbox.txt, runs the single sync command, and does not manually copy only SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: Here is an example skill URL so we can discuss the format: https://github.com/example/skills/tree/main/skills. Do not install it.
evals.expected_output: Does not add anything to skill-inbox.txt and does not run an installation merely because an example URL was provided.
Adds the URL-only collection entry to skill-inbox.txt and runs the one sync command, causing every valid skill folder in the collection to be imported.
